title: Carfax Used Cars Scraper
description: Collect used Carfax vehicles by search URL, make/model, or filters. Output is saved in batches.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Carfax search URL. A custom URL overrides filters. When the URL equals the default example, supplied filters take priority.

location.title: Location
location.description: ZIP code or location to search near. Used with make/model filters.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of vehicles
results_wanted.description: The maximum number of vehicles to collect.

max_pages.title: Maximum number of pages
max_pages.description: A safety cap on the number of search result pages to visit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: No proxy is used by default. Enable Apify Proxy when you need it; Unblocker is the most reliable option and is required for browser-based recovery.
